facts.clause: Vayne tumbles, maneuvering to carefully place her next shot.
Her next attack deals bonus damage.
If they collide with terrain, they are impaled, dealing bonus damage and stunning them.
Vayne draws a heavy crossbow from her back, and fires a huge bolt at her target, knocking them back and dealing damage.
Readying herself for an epic confrontation, Vayne gains increased Attack Damage, Invisibility during Tumble, reduced Tumble cooldown, and more bonus Move Speed from Night Hunter
